verdict.rationale: Community evidence, apparently from a Proton representative, says Proton Pass is open source and links the protonpass GitHub organization. Another commenter observes that the clients specifically are public. The product handles TOTP seeds, but the pack has no first-party documentation, audit, or review record showing that the seed-handling client code is inspectable and community-reviewed. One early commenter could not find the repository, but a later reply links it, so this is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of open-source client repos and licensing, evidence that the TOTP/seed-handling code specifically is published, and independent audit or community-review corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the client apps are open source, so the code handling my seeds can be inspected and community-reviewed

citations.quote: And it is open source: https://github.com/protonpass
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
